description: Configuration header for the Flash Driver in an AUTOSAR-based embedded system, defining macros, data structures, and external references related to flash memory configuration for the MPC5602B microcontroller.

methods.name: FlsAcErase
methods.description: Function pointer for flash erase operation (not supported).
